about_the_game:
Dive into Sea of Thieves with this special edition, which includes a revised copy of the game with all permanent content added since launch, plus a wide-ranging assortment of extra cosmetics and currency.

In addition to a wealth of bonus content – Parrot Hat, Jacket, Dress, Boots, Belt, Trousers, Gloves and 10,000 gold – this edition of the game comes with a further Deluxe Bundle containing the Dire Dark Warsmith Pistol, Blunderbuss, Eye of Reach, Cutlass, Double Barrel Pistol, Throwing Knives, Grapple Gun and Blowpipe.

Additional digital bonuses* include access to the Sea of Thieves Original Soundtrack – 2025 Edition, the Sea of Thieves: Athena's Fortune audiobook and The Rough Guide to Sea of Thieves eBook.

* Available to download from (website login required) or via Steam.
